body: Fixed in 193c39257. manifestDistinguishesSources now validates a per-ID map for every required fixture, rejects duplicates/missing IDs, and the test duplicates one manifest entry while omitting another to verify fail-closed behavior.
Fixed in 193c39257. preAttemptNoMsAssetRefs now explicitly returns false when pre_attempt_blocked is absent, with regression coverage for the missing fixture case.

Fixed in 193c39257. requiredFixtureIdsPresent now uses exact set membership instead of order-sensitive join comparison; regression coverage verifies reordered fixtures pass while duplicate/missing fixtures fail.
Fixed in 193c39257. wordingContractPresent now compares length and each expected line explicitly, with regression coverage preventing JSON serialization tricks from passing.
Fixed in 193c39257. launchVerdictsPresent now validates the exact expected verdict keys and values for rehearsal and closeout, with regression coverage for missing keys and key-order independence.
